prompt:

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the great tree, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Time of day: the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of 2B from Nier: Automata — 2B's look — a black gothic combat dress with feather-trimmed puffed sleeves and a split skirt, black thigh-high boots, white gloves and a black blindfold pushed up onto the forehead, cut as a cropped top and a micro skirt or hot pants that bare the midriff, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush; it is all she holds.
LEGS: crouched on the balls of her feet, knees bent.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it; only the costume's own pieces.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
